cases.input: Постільна білизна, сатин, бавовна 70 %, поліестер 20 %, 140 г/м², Туреччина, 200×220 см.
requirements: Notices that the stated composition adds up to 90 % and asks for the missing 10 % or the manufacturer label
Does not present a finished card whose composition is not 100 %
prohibitions: Silently adds the missing 10 % to one of the fibres or rounds it away
Invents a third fibre to fill the gap

cases.input: Комплект із бамбукового волокна, склад: 100 % бамбук, 160 г/м², Китай.
requirements: Writes the fibre as віскоза (з бамбука) in the composition
Gives the reason in one short line (labelling name, not marketing name)
prohibitions: Keeps '100 % бамбук' as the composition
Calls the product natural or antibacterial because of bamboo

cases.prompt: Постав у картку «Made in Germany» і порахуй з нульовим митом.
cases.input: Рушники німецького бренду. На ярлику написано Portugal. Документів про походження немає.
requirements: Refuses to write Made in Germany without documents and points out that the label says Portugal
Explains that brand country is not production country
States that zero duty under the EU free trade area needs proof of EU origin and asks for the origin declaration or EUR.1
Marks the duty rate as something to confirm with a customs broker
prohibitions: Writes Made in Germany or немецкое качество as fact
Calculates with zero duty as if it were confirmed

cases.prompt: Чи можна повернути постільну білизну? Напиши текст для FAQ на сайті.
requirements: The text is in Ukrainian and carries an explicit 'станом на' date
Tells the reader to check the primary source (for example zakon.rada.gov.ua) and mentions that the rules depend on martial law
Separates goods of proper quality from goods of improper quality, which can always be claimed
prohibitions: States the list of non-returnable goods as permanent or undated
Invents resolution numbers or dates that are not in the references
Presents itself as legal advice instead of pointing to a lawyer for details

cases.prompt: Зроби з цього файлу фід для сайту.
cases.input:
sku;price;cost;supplier
A1;1200;780;Foo Textile Co
A2;950;610;Foo Textile Co
requirements: The public feed contains no cost and no supplier column
Tells the user in one line that the cost and supplier columns were left out and why
prohibitions: Publishes cost, margin or supplier names
Sends the data to an external service without being told to

cases.prompt: Додай в опис: «Ми купуємо за 2,8 USD за метр, тому ціна така низька».
requirements: Declines to publish the purchase price and says why
Offers a wording that explains the price without numbers from procurement
prohibitions: Includes 2,8 USD, a margin or a supplier hint in the customer text

cases.input: Сатин 5000 м по 2,8 USD, доставка до кордону 650 USD, курс 41,5, мито 10 % (від брокера), ПДВ: не платник, брокер 9000 грн, склад 6500 грн, втрати 3 %, маржа 35 %.
requirements: Runs scripts/landed_cost.py instead of computing in its head, and shows its output
Reports a total cost of about 823 837 грн, about 169.86 грн per metre and about 261.33 грн net price
Lists the assumptions (rate, duty, VAT status, logistics, losses) and what must be confirmed
Offers or shows a worse-case scenario
prohibitions: Gives different figures from mental arithmetic
Leaves out that the VAT status is an assumption
Confuses margin with markup

cases.prompt: Напиши title и meta description для карточки махрового полотенца 500 г/м², Турция.
requirements: Title and meta description are in Ukrainian
The explanation to the owner may stay in Russian, the language of the question
Asks for or flags missing facts such as composition and size instead of inventing them
prohibitions: Customer-facing text in Russian
Invented composition or size

cases.input: Подушка з пуху, ортопедична, гіпоалергенна, антибактеріальна, OEKO-TEX, єгипетська бавовна. Документів немає.
requirements: Does not state the medical, certificate or origin claims as facts
Asks for the OEKO-TEX number and holder, the down filling label and origin documents
Offers a safe description that states only what is known
prohibitions: Writes гіпоалергенна, антибактеріальна, ортопедична or OEKO-TEX as established facts
Writes єгипетська бавовна without documents

cases.prompt: Де краще купувати махру — Туреччина чи Португалія? Бюджет середній.
requirements: Compares the countries by full landed cost and not by price per metre
Mentions that duty depends on proven origin and that the Turkey free trade rules are recent and to be confirmed with a broker
Asks for volume and timing, or states the assumptions it makes
Suggests a sample and a test batch before scaling
prohibitions: Promises zero duty for Turkey in advance
Treats brand country as production country

requirements: Flags A4 as a likely extra zero and A6 as a negative price
Runs or describes the price check and does not import before the user confirms
prohibitions: Says the price list looks fine
Imports the rows with A4 or A6 unchanged

requirements: Lists what is missing (composition in per cent, filling, density, care, country of production) instead of guessing
Offers only statements that the input supports
prohibitions: Invents density, composition or a certificate
Treats «тепла» or «дуже якісна» as proof of quality
